# Tierra Firme

> A consortium of three practitioners in commercial real estate, business and family capital, and research. Tierra Firme produces a free show, sourced answers and seminars for people placing capital across borders, starting with Latin America. Based in Dallas and Bogotá; works globally. Educational only: no listings, no transactions, no investment advice.

## Members and lanes
- Murphy D. Cheatham II, The Asset (commercial real estate): Private Clients Director at CBRE, a global role advising private families and high net worth individuals.
- Shawn Christopher Leamon, The Capital (business and family capital): founder and managing partner of LaGrande Global (since 2013), an investment firm managing close to $100 million with a focus on Latin America, and founder and CEO of Cielo.Travel, Bogotá.
- Todd Allyn, The Country (research): leads Tierra Firme research. Founding Director of Sovereo Intelligence Research (https://www.sovereo.com), whose Global Deal Record (https://www.sovereo.com/deal-record) has tracked US$46.0 billion in business deals so far, including US$3.84 billion in Colombia (Sovereo Desk, The Global Deal Record). Professor of economics and decision science for over 24 years. Bogotá.

## Event
- [Tierra Firme Investor Lab 2027](https://www.tierrafirme.lat/colombia-2027): preliminary. 6 days, 5 nights, 7 to 12 March 2027: 3 days in Bogotá, 2 in Medellín. Exclusive group. Short boardroom briefings, verified field visits, cultural evenings. Education, not advice.

## Questions investors ask (sourced answers)
- [Can foreigners buy property in Colombia?](https://www.tierrafirme.lat/questions/can-foreigners-buy-property-in-colombia): Yes, with the same ownership rights as Colombians, if the money comes in through the formal exchange market and is registered.
- [Why do you have to register a foreign investment in Colombia?](https://www.tierrafirme.lat/questions/register-foreign-investment-in-colombia): Registration with Banco de la República is what protects your right to move the money and the sale proceeds back out.
- [What taxes do foreigners pay on property in Colombia?](https://www.tierrafirme.lat/questions/taxes-foreigners-pay-on-property-in-colombia): Closing costs when you buy, annual predial while you own, tax on rent, and 15% capital gains tax when you sell after two years.
- [How does the exchange rate change your return on property abroad?](https://www.tierrafirme.lat/questions/how-the-exchange-rate-changes-your-real-estate-return): Your return is the local price change plus or minus the currency move. A strong local gain can disappear when converted home.
- [Can buying property in Colombia get you a visa?](https://www.tierrafirme.lat/questions/colombia-investor-visa-through-real-estate): It can support an M investor visa if the property is worth at least 350 monthly minimum wages, in your name, and registered with the central bank.
- [What is propiedad horizontal in Colombia?](https://www.tierrafirme.lat/questions/what-is-propiedad-horizontal-in-colombia): The legal regime for buildings and gated communities: you own your unit, share the common areas, and pay a mandatory administration fee.
- [What are currency, political and structural arbitrage?](https://www.tierrafirme.lat/questions/currency-political-and-structural-arbitrage): Three reasons the same money can buy more abroad, and three matching risks that decide whether the gap is real.
- [How do you evaluate a country before investing there?](https://www.tierrafirme.lat/questions/how-to-evaluate-a-country-before-investing): Information, evaluation, interpretation, then action: gather sourced facts, test them, read what they mean for you, and only then commit.

## Notes
- Tierra Firme does not list property, arrange transactions or take fees on what anyone buys.
- Nothing published by Tierra Firme is investment, tax or legal advice.
